portfolio_cases_subway_p1: Websites should finally be fun again — playfully introducing users to the client's brand world. At Subway, we achieved this by distilling our focus down to the essential communication goals: [ Action – Fun – Sport ].
portfolio_cases_subway_p2:
After years of relying on a WordPress website, Subway sought a digital presence that would keep open all the possibilities offered by modern websites today — one that could be expanded with a Headless CMS if needed, and, if necessary, additionally integrated with a Headless Commerce system.

By utilizing SvelteKit, we successfully met these requirements. Furthermore, thanks to SvelteKit’s native animation libraries, we were able to implement a unique navigation concept.
portfolio_cases_werkd_p1:
Following the modernization of its brand identity, werk d required a digital presence that conveys craftsmanship, design excellence, and technical sophistication by prioritizing immersiveness.

Since werk d creates unique surfaces in collaboration with the interior design and architecture sectors, this project necessitated unique functional libraries and diverse media implementation strategies to ensure the brand is perceived with the same level of sophistication as the spaces it helps to shape.
portfolio_cases_werkd_p2: As a central element of our tech stack, we utilize SvelteKit to seamlessly integrate any extension requests the client may have for a headless CMS. This project is currently in its final implementation phase.

engineering_services_websites_architectu:
By leveraging composable and headless architectures, your company can build flexible and scalable digital platforms. Decoupling frontend and backend systems provides you with unparalleled customization options, rapid development cycles, and an outstanding user experience while maintaining backend stability.

From conceptualization to design to UI development and cross-browser testing, we push the boundaries of what's possible in frontend development. We integrate design thinking methodologies—including discovery, empathizing, research, ideation, prototyping, and testing — to maximize your customer experiences through tailored state-of-the-art frontend technologies.

With an API-first approach, our composable architecture gives you control over your website and app’s structure, allowing for easy adaptability. This flexibility means you can quickly respond to market changes or add new features without rebuilding your entire platform.

By adopting advanced frameworks like SvelteKit, we create fast-loading websites that enhance user experience and improve SEO. Our use of techniques like Static Site Generation (SSG) and Server-Side Rendering (SSR) means your site loads quickly and performs optimally, keeping visitors engaged and boosting conversion rates.

We prioritize creating intuitive and responsive interfaces that provide a remarkable user experience across all devices. Using tools like Figma, Tailwind CSS, and Component Libraries like bitsUI, your site’s design is visually appealing and highly functional, boosting user satisfaction and engagement.

We rely on Headless CMS solutions to separate your content management from the frontend development. This decoupled approach allows for faster content updates, empowers marketing teams, and offers greater flexibility, so your site always provides fresh, relevant information.

Our frontend development services include SEO best practices as well as AEO optimization, from optimizing site structure to fast load times. A website optimized for AI agents achieves better positioning in search engine AI overviews, attracts more organic traffic, and thereby fosters your growth and online visibility.

We set up robust CI/CD pipelines - and with Railway or Coolify as our preferred deployment platforms, your website is hosted on a reliable, high-performance infrastructure. Performance optimization, cross-browser and cross-device testing, and continuous monitoring and maintenance keep your site running flawlessly from launch to long-term operation.
